name: Leading By Example
overview: Scripture calls believers to lead by example, demonstrating godly character and faithfulness in both word and deed. Jesus teaches that His followers are the light of the world, visible and influential like a city set on a hill, encouraging them to live in a way that reflects His overcoming peace amid trials. Leaders are exhorted to be patterns of good works and integrity, faithfully guiding others with sincere doctrine and godly conduct. Those under such leadership are instructed to obey and submit, recognizing that their leaders are accountable to God and should lead with joy, not grief.
